project_type: Python FastAPI backend with SQLAlchemy ORM, PostgreSQL-ready database
build_system: Python virtual environment at backend/.venv, pip for dependencies
verification_instructions: Run pytest on specific test files after implementation. Use scripts from backend/scripts/ for data validation and walk-forward execution.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None - tests generate temporary data, scripts write JSON reports to .agents/tasks/ directory
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell environment. Python 3.12.10 with venv at backend/.venv. Database uses SQLAlchemy with SQLite for development (PostgreSQL-ready architecture). Never fabricate data. Temporal leakage protection mandatory: use strict < comparison with before_datetime.
contribution_requirements: AGENTS.md rules: inspect before editing, work in verifiable steps, never claim working unless verified, label mock data explicitly, never fabricate statistics, numerical engines are source of truth, fix errors found during verification, update docs/PROGRESS.md after completion
key_patterns: Dataclass-based feature structures (ShotIntelligenceMetrics, ShotProduction). MatchWithStatistics pattern for temporal validity. Calculator classes with calculate() methods accepting before_datetime parameter. Strict temporal filtering: match.scheduled_at < before_datetime. Test files in tests/ mirror app/ structure. Scripts in backend/scripts/ use SessionLocal() for DB access.
directory_structure: backend/app/features/ (feature calculators), backend/app/prediction/ (prediction engines, interfaces), backend/app/backtesting/ (NEW - walk-forward validation), backend/tests/ (mirrors app/ structure), backend/scripts/ (standalone validation/execution scripts), .agents/tasks/shot-market-validation/ (FEAT artifacts and results)
